selection_reason: 训练照片的逐组相对姿态在第24组到第26组之间出现分段变化；早期和后期独立拟合的相对旋转Y分量约为-1.69度与-2.31度。采用第26至46组作为最近一段，保守排除第25组过渡照片及此前状态。该判断未用验证误差删选照片。
coordinate_convention: raw sensor x-right y-down; X_right=R*X_left+T; T and Q depths in mm
limitations: Screen scale is user measured, not independently verified
Software timestamp pairing; hardware exposure synchronization unverified
Holdout images were not fitted, but were inspected during diagnosis; new untouched acceptance captures are required
No independent known-distance or mapping validation
Parameters are valid only for unchanged lenses, focus, mounting and sensor image geometry
